projectDescription: A governance-first multi-agent AI executive assistant that runs on your own server, managing email, calendar, contacts, research, and scheduling — with a full audit trail and configurable autonomy.
keyFeatures: Multi-agent AI executive assistant with a unified coordinator persona
Governance-first architecture with hard layer separation and append-only audit trail
Persistent knowledge graph with temporal awareness and semantic search
Multi-channel support: Email (via Nylas), Signal, CLI, and HTTP API
Configurable autonomy engine with five behavioral bands (0–100 score)
Scheduled and long-running tasks with intent drift detection
Secrets never reach the LLM — scoped secret access with full audit logging
MCP (Model Context Protocol) skill integration for external tool connectivity
Single-tenant, self-hosted — all data stays on your own server
Multi-provider LLM support: Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama with automatic fallback
publicApiSurface: POST /api/messages — send a message and receive an agent response
GET /api/messages/stream — SSE stream for real-time agent events
SkillHandler interface — TypeScript interface for custom skill implementation
SkillContext interface — injected context available to skill handlers
ChannelAdapter interface — TypeScript interface for custom channel adapters
scheduler-create / scheduler-list / scheduler-cancel skills (cron and one-shot jobs)
